visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand uses dark chopsticks to place multiple white, leaf-shaped fish cakes into a dual-compartment hot pot. One side contains a bright red spicy broth, and the other a milky white soup. Plates of fried dough sticks and raw cabbage are visible in the background on a marble table with bright indoor lighting. (2) The scene cuts to a large, industrial-sized wok where a person uses a metal spatula to vigorously stir-fry a dense mixture of dried red chilies and Sichuan peppercorns. The texture of the spices is oily and vibrant. (3) A ladle stirs a large pot of creamy, ivory-colored bone broth that includes red goji berries. The shot is a tight close-up focusing on the liquid's consistency. (4) Red spicy broth is ladled into a pot, followed by a scoop showing large pieces of dark duck blood and cubes of tofu dripping with soup. (5) Vegetables, including slices of pumpkin and cabbage, are ladled into the mild broth. (6) A shot shows a self-service beverage station with various machines. Then, a black coffee mug is filled by an automated machine, followed by a scoop of white rice being served into a black bowl. (7) A hand with metal tongs picks a thin, speckled cracker from a glass jar. Then, creamy yellow soft-serve ice cream is dispensed into a cup. (8) Multiple rectangular platters filled with rolls of raw red meat (beef, pork, lamb) are presented on the table. A hand dips a slice of meat into the bubbling red broth. (9) A person opens a commercial refrigerator filled with small plates of pre-portioned ingredients wrapped in plastic. (10) Various cooked items are showcased: fish cakes held with chopsticks, meatballs in a spicy soup ladle, and golden-brown moon shrimp cakes in a bamboo basket. (11) The camera pans across the interior of the restaurant, showing rows of clean white marble tables and black chairs under bright studio-like lighting. (12) An exterior shot of the building facade reveals the sign '鼎星火鍋店' with colorful balloons at the entrance.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Process -> Menu Showcase -> Amenities -> Specialties -> Information -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy promotional advertisement for '鼎星經典火鍋店' in Kaohsiung. It aims to attract customers by highlighting its 20-year history, the authentic handmade process of its spicy broth base, and the extensive value of its self-service bar (free rice, drinks, and snacks). The fast-paced editing and detailed close-ups of ingredients create a sense of abundance and culinary quality designed to trigger appetite and foot traffic.
